source_label: Official BC public emergency guidance sources.
notes: Policy snippets are paraphrased from public BC guidance. They are not official agency SOPs and do not authorize FireGuard to issue emergency instructions.

records.title: Evacuation order means leave immediately
records.body: For public guidance, a BC evacuation order indicates immediate risk and people in the affected area should leave as directed by local authorities and use designated support locations.

records.title: Evacuation alert means prepare to leave
records.body: For public guidance, a BC evacuation alert indicates people should be ready to leave on short notice while continuing to follow local authority updates.

records.title: Emergency alerts may direct evacuation or shelter-in-place
records.body: For public guidance, emergency alert recipients should read the full alert, verify whether they are in the impacted area, follow the listed direction, and check official local sources when safe.

records.title: FireGuard approval gate for public or dispatch actions
records.body: FireGuard must not execute resident alerts, evacuation instructions, shelter-in-place instructions, road operations tasks, or dispatch movement without explicit human approval in the demo workflow.
